mapper.sql: FROM food f LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = f.category_id WHERE f.status = 1 AND f.category_id = #{categoryId} AND (f.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR f.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select:
SELECT f.id, f.category_id, c.name AS category_name, f.name, f.description, f.price, f.original_price, f.image_url, f.stock, f.sales, f.recommended, f.special_offer, f.status, f.created_at, f.updated_at
ORDER BY f.recommended DESC, f.sales DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT f.id, f.category_id, c.name AS category_name, f.name, f.description, f.price, f.original_price, f.image_url, f.stock, f.sales, f.recommended, f.special_offer, f.status, f.created_at, f.updated_at FROM food f LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = f.category_id WHERE f.id = #{id} AND f.status = 1

SELECT f.id, f.category_id, c.name AS category_name, f.name, f.description, f.price, f.original_price, f.image_url, f.stock, f.sales, f.recommended, f.special_offer, f.status, f.created_at, f.updated_at FROM food f LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = f.category_id WHERE f.id = #{id} AND f.status = 1 FOR UPDATE
